description_en: Queries the list of security events detected by API security basic detection
description_zh: 查询API安全基础检测的安全事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-free-user-events --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-27a30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFreeUserEvents

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Event.description_en: The list of security events detected by basic detection
Event.description_zh: 基础检测的安全事件列表

items.description_en: The security event information detected by basic detection
items.description_zh: 基础检测的安全事件信息

AttackTime.description_en: The attack time. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
AttackTime.description_zh: 攻击时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒

Domain.description_en: The domain name to which the API operation belongs

EventLevel.description_en:
The event level. Valid values:
high: high risk.
medium: medium risk.
low: low risk
EventLevel.description_zh:
事件等级。取值：
high：表示高危。
medium：表示中危。
low：表示低危

EventTag.description_en:
The event type.
You can call the [DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html） operation to obtain the supported event types
EventTag.description_zh:
事件类型。
您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html）获取支持的事件类型
